title: Logout failure leaves access/refresh tokens in SecureStorage; post-logout redirect is unregistered
owner_hint: top committer: Michael Stonis (4 of 4 recent commits); no CODEOWNERS entry
rationale: SignOutAsync returns on LogoutAsync error before the only token wipe, the post-logout URI mismatches the registered value, and the caller ignores the result. The diff clears the token in a finally block, converts provider errors into a false result, appends /Account/Redirecting to the post-logout URI, and surfaces a failure alert.
variants_checked: Sign-in, refresh, mock service and the profile caller checked; the browser callback activity has no path restriction so the extra path is still delivered.
bypass_considered: All provider outcomes (error, cancel, missing endpoint, exception) now reach the finally and clear the token. Residual: if the keystore write itself throws, the token remains; a dedicated remove path with retry is a follow-up.
test_note: Added SignOutClearsStoredTokenWhenProviderLogoutFailsTest using MockSettingsService and a failing override.
review_reason: Clearing the stored token in finally eliminates the masked failure where an errored LogoutAsync returned early, and the redirect hunk matches the server registration. The caller now surfaces the failure; only noise is the broad catch and the test seam.
